title: SNAX-FORGE streamer file
description: <slot>_streamer.hjson: a slot's streamer template as snax_cluster's hjson has it, lowered per design point (snax_forge/gen/gvsoc.py, D134). Readers are the input ports in the BRM's port order, writers the output ports; per group, one list entry per mover.

spatial_bounds.description: Per mover, its spatial loops' bounds, fastest first.

num_channel.description: Per mover, its 64-bit TCDM channels: the slot's snax_tcdm_ports is their sum.

fifo_depth.description: Per mover, its data FIFO's depth.
